payload.title: Child's Creative Vision
payload.celebration: Wonderful use of imagination and bold colors!
payload.scene_description: A heartfelt composition featuring the child's original subjects and spatial arrangement.
payload.enhancement_prompt: Refine lighting, color harmony, and edge definition while preserving original line character and child's marks. Enhance textures and depth without altering composition or subjects. Keep original marks visible as intentional artistic choices.
payload.heightmap_guidance: Follow original subject silhouettes for elevation; maintain flat planes for background.
